title: Classic Lamingtons
description: Australian cubes of butter sponge dipped in chocolate and rolled in coconut.

steps.title: Cream butter and sugar
steps.body: Cream {{ butter }} and {{ sugar }} until light and fluffy, about 4 minutes.

steps.title: Add eggs
steps.body: Add {{ eggs }} one at a time, beating well after each. Stir in {{ vanilla }}.

steps.title: Fold in flour and milk
steps.body: Sift in {{ flour.name }}, then alternate folding in flour and {{ milk }} in three additions.

steps.title: Bake
steps.body: Pour into a lined 20x30cm tin and bake at 180°C for @timer(25m) until a skewer comes out clean.

steps.title: Cool overnight
steps.body: Cool the cake from @step(sponge.4) completely, then chill overnight — this firms it up so it won't crumble when dipped.

steps.title: Cut into cubes
steps.body: Trim the edges and cut into 16 even squares.

steps.title: Make chocolate icing
steps.body: Sift {{ icing_sugar }} and {{ cocoa }} together. Melt {{ coating_butter }} into {{ coating_milk }}, then whisk into the dry mix until smooth and glossy.

steps.title: Dip and roll
steps.body: Spread {{ coconut }} on a tray. Dip each cube from @step(prepare.2) into the icing from @step(coating.1), let excess drip, then roll in coconut to coat. Set on a wire rack to dry.
